== Title ==
<span lang="ja">反乱軍分隊指揮官</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">兵員／トルーパーと「反乱軍衛兵」からなるきっかり3人の“分隊”とともに移動する場合、1フォースで4人全員が移動できる。同じ位置カード上の兵員／トルーパーおよび「反乱軍衛兵」はそれぞれ没収値＋1。「反乱軍衛兵」は分隊指揮官と一緒であれば移動可能となる（フォースは通常通り消費する）。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ペロー・スクランバス中尉は反乱軍の古参士官の類型と言える。ほぼ20年に渡ってオーガナ家に仕え、オルデラン総督家の護衛官としての職務を忠実に果たしてきた。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Rebel Squad Leader]].

'''Lore''' — Lieutenant Pello Scrambas is a typical veteran Rebel officer. For nearly 20 years he served the Organa family and faithfully performed his duty as a guard of the Alderaan governor's house.

'''Game text''' — When moving with a squad of exactly 3 troopers and Rebel Guards, all 4 may move for 1 Force. Troopers and Rebel Guards on the same location card are each forfeit +1. Rebel Guards can move if they are with the squad leader, spending Force as usual.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Japanese uses きっかり, 兵員／トルーパー, 位置カード, and 「反乱軍衛兵」. English says exactly three troopers and/or Rebel Guards at same site.<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-rebelsquadleader-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Rebel Squad Leader]].</ref>
